name: Mito Akari
source:
The protagonist's sister-in-law. She is in her early 20's and has been married for about two years. She has huge breast and a nice body but she is embarrassed about her huge chest size.
She is still somewhat of a innocent bride and is a full time housewife, and because her husband is busy with work and they use birth control during sex, she doesn't yet have children.
